title: NEB Class 11 Physics — Electric Charges — 2022
subject: physics
source: NEB Grade 11 Model Questions / NEB Past Papers 2020-2024

questions.question: Two charges of +2 microC and -3 microC are placed 0.6 m apart. The force between them is: (a) 0.15 N attractive (b) 0.15 N repulsive (c) 1.5 N attractive (d) 0.05 N repulsive
questions.solution:
**Correct option: (a) 0.15 N attractive.**

**Step 1 — Magnitude of the force:**
$$F = \frac{1}{4\pi\varepsilon_0}\frac{q_1q_2}{r^2} = 9 \times 10^9 \times \frac{(2 \times 10^{-6})(3 \times 10^{-6})}{(0.6)^2}$$
$$F = 9 \times 10^9 \times \frac{6 \times 10^{-12}}{0.36} = 9 \times 10^9 \times 1.67 \times 10^{-11}$$
$$F = \mathbf{0.15\ \text{N}}$$

**Step 2 — Direction:** The charges have **opposite** signs, so the force is **attractive**.

Hence the correct answer is option **(a)**, and options (b), (c) and (d) are wrong.
questions.knowledgeNote: Opposite charges attract; using nine times ten to the ninth gives 0.15 newtons for these microCoulomb charges.
